card.name: Linking words before military institutions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, of, in, the) and titles like Secretary right before a military or defense institution name such as War College, Department of Defense, or Military College. Seen in general web text about armed forces and security studies.

modes.label: Link before defense institution
modes.description: A preposition or article just before a military school or department name.
modes.example: Department of War Studies<< at>> King's College London

modes.label: Defense title
modes.description: A title or word within 'Secretary of Defense'.
modes.example: then Secretary of<< Defense>> Robert Gates stated that

card.writes: It promotes police, defence and military words, so it predicts that a military or police institution name comes next.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before a military or defense organization is named.
